info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Business Control By Param1-spec
info.description: The Business Control Retrieval API allows users to access specific business control information based on a provided parameter. This API is designed for financial institutions seeking to analyze or manage organizational directions under varying circumstances. It primarily serves developers and analysts involved in banking operations, enabling them to obtain critical insights and data for decision-making. By utilizing this endpoint, applications can streamline information retrieval regarding business controls, making it essential for effective banking management.

get.description: Fetches the details of a specific organization direction identified by its unique ID. This endpoint allows clients to obtain essential information regarding the organization's direction for business control purposes.

requestBody.description: This request body contains information necessary to retrieve the organizational direction for the specified resource. It is expected to follow the defined schema for organization direction operations.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the requested resource details.

businessUnitId.description: The unique identifier of the business unit.

planningPeriod.description: The planning period for which the operations data is applicable.
